Put a thumb anywhere on the left half and drag to walk or run. Drag anywhere else on the right side to look around.

Tap a button to use it. Hold Menu for system settings, Inventory for stats and the journal, and Draw to pick a weapon, spell or item. Keep the finger down, drag toward a choice and let go. With a weapon drawn, press Attack and quickly drag in any direction to lock onto a target, and do it again to unlock.

• Two fingers left: health potion
• Two fingers right: mana potion
• Two fingers down on the left: sneak, up: stand up
• Two fingers up on the right: first person
• Two fingers down on the right and hold: look behind
• Three-finger tap: quicksave
• Four-finger tap: quickload

Tap an item to select it and tap it again to use, equip or take it. Hold a potion, food or a document to add it to the Draw wheel, and hold it again to remove it. Tap free space to close the inventory.

Tap an answer to pick it, or anywhere else to skip a line, a video or a chapter screen. Tap menu items directly, and tap outside a menu to close it. Hide the buttons in Options › Game Settings › Touch UI.
